bridge-type.label: Navimow Account
bridge-type.description: Connects to the Navimow cloud service and manages MQTT real-time updates.

parameter.name: accessToken
parameter.label: Access Token
parameter.description: OAuth2 access token for the Navimow cloud. Obtain this from your Navimow connected app or Home Assistant integration.

parameter.name: pollingInterval
parameter.label: Polling Interval
parameter.description: Interval in seconds for HTTP fallback polling. Set to 0 to disable polling (MQTT only).

parameter.name: apiBaseUrl
parameter.label: API Base URL
parameter.description: Override the Navimow API base URL. Leave empty to use the default.

thing-type.label: Navimow Mower
thing-type.description: A Segway Navimow robotic lawn mower.

parameter.name: deviceId
parameter.label: Device ID
parameter.description: The unique device ID of the Navimow mower.

channel-type.label: Status
channel-type.description: Current operational state of the mower.

channel-type.label: Signal Strength
channel-type.description: RSSI signal strength of the mower (dBm).

channel-type.label: Latitude
channel-type.description: Current GPS latitude of the mower.

channel-type.label: Longitude
channel-type.description: Current GPS longitude of the mower.

channel-type.label: Error Code
channel-type.description: Error code reported by the mower, or "none" if there is no error.

channel-type.label: Command
channel-type.description: Send a command to the mower.
